history.summary: Large 2,230 sqft 4BR at Queens, a 2002 D03 leasehold literally on top of Queenstown MRT (170m). Excellent 6.0%/yr resale CAGR on 99 txns and priced below median at $1,785 psf, but the $3.98M quantum sits well above the liquid sweet spot, which the low score_1000 (480) reflects.
history.rating_rationale: The development fundamentals are strong — 6.0%/yr resale CAGR (99 txns), 170m to Queenstown MRT, GSW catalyst, sub-median PSF ($1,785 vs $1,886) — and the high elo 1551 reflects that. But this specific $3.98M large-4BR unit sits far above the $1.8-2.5M deep-liquidity band; the buyer pool for a near-$4M 24-year-old leasehold 4BR is thin, which is exactly why score_1000 is only 480. Strong asset, weak exit liquidity at this quantum.
red_flags: $3.98M quantum far above the liquid sweet spot; shallow buyer pool for large 4BR
2002 build (24 years old) with 99yr lease — lease decay accelerating
catalysts: 170m to Queenstown EW MRT — top-tier connectivity
Greater Southern Waterfront transformation of D03/D04
